hero.label: Entry systems
hero.headline: ENTRY
hero.intro: The design and mounting system for true individuality at the entrance. Entry opens up creative freedom: with screw-free mounting and systematic integration of all entrance functions in an individually selected design.

derEingang.label: The entrance
derEingang.title: A highly functional place
derEingang.text: Many functions of the building envelope come together at the entrance: delivering, storing, calling, seeing, speaking, identifying and entering. The entrance is the architectural hotspot and the user interface of the building.

herstellerGewerke.label: Manufacturers and trades
herstellerGewerke.title: Plan across trades
herstellerGewerke.text: Installations from different manufacturers are not just placed side by side but integrated into a unified mounting system. This cross-manufacturer planning approach ensures that the entrance fulfils its representative role.

lifecycle.label: Think lifecycle
lifecycle.title: Anticipate change
lifecycle.text: Companies change their names, tenants move and new functions are added. An entrance system must anticipate changing usage patterns over its lifecycle and prove its integration capability.

discover.title: Discover Entry
discover.intro: From design and materials to functionality, integration, references, standards and consulting.

design.title: Design
design.subtitle: Form follows idea.
design.description: Entry enables individual designs. From a wide range of options, designs can be developed for compact tableaus, multifunctional terminals and large-scale design bands.

funktionalitaet.title: Functionality
funktionalitaet.subtitle: Electrical and mechanical installations
funktionalitaet.description: Functionality in the building envelope is concentrated at the entrance as the interface between outside and inside – from door communication to fire protection.

hero.label: Entry / Design
hero.headline: Design
hero.intro: Entry enables individual designs. From a wide range of options, designs can be developed for compact tableaus, multifunctional terminals and large-scale design bands. They accentuate the entrance and make the architecture tangible and usable.

tableausTerminals.subtitle: Tailored to individual needs
tableausTerminals.title: Tableaus and terminals
tableausTerminals.text: A single installation can combine all the functionality required at an entrance – systematically integrated in a homogeneous design.
tableausTerminals.imageAlt: Large Entry station in stainless steel with door communication, call buttons, street name, house number, parcel box, letterboxes and fire-protection installation

gestaltungsbaender.subtitle: For representative entrance and façade functions
gestaltungsbaender.title: Design bands
gestaltungsbaender.text: Design bands can integrate not only entrance functions but also façade functions such as signage.
gestaltungsbaender.imageAlt: Entry design band in brass with door communication and signage

hero.label: Entry / Integration forms
hero.headline: Integration forms
hero.intro: Installations at the entrance can be integrated into the façade in various ways or anchored in front of the building structure. Different integration forms are available for the main façade types.

inPutz.subtitle: With recessed front
inPutz.title: Flush-mount installation
inPutz.text: With flush-mount installation, the metalwork installation is fully integrated into the wall within a mounting frame. The 3 mm thick front is set flush into the mounting frame.
inPutz.imageAlt: Metalwork installation in flush, wall-aligned mounting

unterPutz.subtitle: With overlapping front
unterPutz.title: Recessed installation
unterPutz.text: With recessed installation, the metalwork installation is mounted on a flush-mount box. The front and front frame fully cover the flush-mount box and rest on the wall.
unterPutz.imageAlt: Metalwork installation in recessed mounting with overlapping front

aufPutz.subtitle: With laterally visible housing
aufPutz.title: Surface-mount installation
aufPutz.text: With surface mounting, an installation with the smallest possible depth (approx. 30–50 mm) is mounted on the wall in a laterally visible mounting box. The advantage: easy implementation without wall recesses.
aufPutz.imageAlt: Metalwork installation in surface mounting with laterally visible frame

freistehend.subtitle: As a free-standing stele visible from all sides
freistehend.title: Free-standing
freistehend.text: In this mounting form, the building structure and the metalwork installation have no direct mounting relationship. The installation as a column or stele is installed on a foundation anchor or base directly on a foundation.
freistehend.imageAlt: Metalwork installation in free-standing mounting with visible column body

hero.label: Entry / Material
hero.headline: Material
hero.intro: Choosing the right material is decisive – for the perceived quality and the first impression that the architecture leaves on contact. The selection is broad – from cool and discreet to vibrant and classical.

aluminium.subtitle: Ground, blasted and anodised
aluminium.title: Aluminium
aluminium.text: The surface of aluminium can be processed smooth or structured by blasting or grinding. Corrosion protection and colouring are achieved by anodising – a finishing process for optimal protection and coloured decor.
aluminium.imageAlt: Aluminium surface ground, blasted and anodised

edelstahl.subtitle: Ground, brushed, polished … colour-coated
edelstahl.title: Stainless steel
edelstahl.text: The surface of stainless steel can be structured by grinding, brushing or polishing. PVD coating creates uniform, UV-resistant decorative colours that are extremely robust and corrosion-resistant.
edelstahl.imageAlt: Stainless steel surface ground, brushed and PVD-coated

messingSatiniert.subtitle: Ground, sealed … burnished
messingSatiniert.title: Satin-finished brass
messingSatiniert.text: A copper alloy with a zinc content of up to 40% produces a golden-yellow, shiny appearance. The lower the zinc content, the redder or more copper-coloured the brass appears.

bronzeBaubronze.subtitle: Patinated
bronzeBaubronze.title: Bronze | architectural bronze
bronzeBaubronze.text: Bronze is an alloy of copper and tin. The natural red-brown to black surface patina develops through external influences. Artificial patination intensifies the decorative effects.

pulverbeschichtung.subtitle: Colours according to the RAL fan
pulverbeschichtung.title: Coloured powder coating
pulverbeschichtung.text: Powder coating is a process for applying colour to electrically conductive materials such as aluminium or stainless steel. Powder coatings are available for almost all colours in the RAL colour fan.
pulverbeschichtung.imageAlt: Powder coating in all colours of the RAL fan

mineralwerkstoff.subtitle: Corian, Himacs, Getalit, Varicor
mineralwerkstoff.title: Mineral material
mineralwerkstoff.text: Decorative panel materials in a broad design spectrum, made of ground minerals, acrylic and natural pigments. Suitable as front panel material for installations in protected outdoor or indoor areas.
mineralwerkstoff.imageAlt: Front panels made of mineral materials for special designs
features: Wide variety of decors and colours
For protected outdoor or indoor areas

hero.label: Entry / Standards
hero.headline: Standards
hero.intro: For high-quality door communication, you will find here standards for mounting sets that can be completed with functional modules. The resulting outdoor stations are available in two mounting forms and can hold up to six functional modules.

unterputzAmi.label: Data sheet AMI series recessed mounting

inputzAmi.label: Data sheet AMI series flush-mount installation

unterputzmontage.subtitle: Mounting sets for outdoor stations
unterputzmontage.title: Recessed mounting
unterputzmontage.text: With this recessed mounting, the front is enclosed by a frame. This frame covers the plaster connection of the mounting box except for the surrounding joint.
unterputzmontage.imageAlt: Outdoor station in recessed mounting with surrounding frame

inputzmontage.subtitle: Mounting sets for outdoor stations
inputzmontage.title: Flush-mount installation
inputzmontage.text: With flush-mount installation, the metalwork installation is fully integrated into the wall within a mounting frame. The 3 mm thick stainless steel front is set flush with the plaster into the 2 mm thick mounting frame.
inputzmontage.imageAlt: Outdoor station in flush-mount installation with stainless steel front

funktionsmoduleAmi.subtitle: For combination with the mounting sets
funktionsmoduleAmi.title: Functional modules AMI series
funktionsmoduleAmi.text: Individually combined with each other in a mounting set, these modules can be used to create outdoor stations for door communication, access and usage control.
funktionsmoduleAmi.imageAlt: Functional modules of the AMI series for door communication, access and usage control

hero.label: Entry / Consulting
hero.headline: Consulting
hero.intro: We advise on private and professional building projects, general contractors, project development, architecture, specialist planning and system integration, as well as the housing industry and the installation trade.

konzept.title: Concept and design topics
konzept.intro: Our project consulting offers expert support for design and technology topics related to the entrance.
items: Technology forms for control surfaces and input devices
Integration forms in façade types (plaster, curtain, clinker, glass, natural stone)

technologie.title: Technology topics
technologie.intro: We advise on all technological aspects related to the building entrance.
items: Access and usage control with network integration
Guidance and orientation, wayfinding, company signage
Communication technology for fire brigade announcements
Ambient Assisted Living (AAL) and home care

cta.title: Discuss your project?
cta.text: Contact us for individual consulting on your building project – also on site.

hero.label: Entry / Functionality
hero.headline: Functionality
hero.intro: Functionality in the building envelope is concentrated at the entrance as the interface between outside and inside. In addition to representative functions such as house number, signage, letterboxes or call panel, mandatory functions for fire protection or building management can also be integrated into a mounting system.

tuerkommunikation.subtitle: Display of call destinations for communicating with visitors
tuerkommunikation.title: Door and building communication
tuerkommunikation.text: Depending on the system size and level of representation, door communication offers various forms of displaying call destinations – from bell buttons with paper inserts and call buttons with engraved names to electronic name displays on a touchscreen.
tuerkommunikation.imageAlt: Door and building communication with various forms of displaying call destinations
features: Internal communication and automatic door opener

accessControl.subtitle: Techniques for controlling access and usage
accessControl.title: Access Control
accessControl.text: Access to the building can be conveniently organised for recurring users with the help of electronic access control. The technology ranges from a code lock and transponder reader to a biometric fingerprint scanner.
accessControl.imageAlt: Electronic access control with code lock, transponder reader and fingerprint scanner

verwahrung.subtitle: Letterbox, parcel box and key safe
verwahrung.title: Storage
verwahrung.text: The secure storage of mail or of keys for security and rescue services requires technical solutions. In addition to letterboxes and parcel boxes, key safes from well-known manufacturers can also be integrated into an Entry installation.
verwahrung.imageAlt: Letterbox, parcel box and key safe in an Entry installation

gebaeudesicherheit.subtitle: Surveillance, announcements and fire protection
gebaeudesicherheit.title: Building security and fire protection
gebaeudesicherheit.text: Installations for building surveillance such as video cameras or motion detectors can be integrated into an installation. The same applies to fire brigade announcements and fire protection installations such as FSE, FSD, fire-water supply equipment or BMA.
gebaeudesicherheit.imageAlt: Building security and fire protection installations with FSE, FSD and BMA

wayfinding.subtitle: Wayfinding for public spaces and private residential environments
wayfinding.title: Guidance, orientation, information
wayfinding.text: In addition to displaying the street or building name, company signage and corporate elements are common in commercial construction. Pictograms point to important facilities.
wayfinding.imageAlt: Wayfinding with door and information signs, pictograms and house numbers

beleuchtung.subtitle: For control surfaces, the façade and pathways
beleuchtung.title: Lighting
beleuchtung.text: Lighting solutions such as uplights and downlights or backlights serve as decorative light on the façade but, as technical lighting, can also illuminate control surfaces and information displays.
beleuchtung.imageAlt: Lighting solutions with uplights, downlights and backlights for façade and control surfaces

service.subtitle: Energy generation and supply
service.title: Service, management and energy
service.text: Various service functions can be integrated into a metalwork installation – from charging stations for e-vehicles to sockets for building cleaning and photovoltaic panels in the façade.
service.imageAlt: Service functions with charging stations, sockets and photovoltaic panels in the façade

hero.label: Entry / References
hero.headline: References
hero.intro: Object-specific Entry installations have been realised in numerous residential and commercial buildings. In close coordination with architecture, electrical planning and the building project, unique installations have been created in terms of function, design and integration form.

forumMuseumsinsel.subtitle: Contemporary in architectural bronze
forumMuseumsinsel.title: Forum an der Museumsinsel, Berlin
forumMuseumsinsel.description: Eight listed buildings directly adjacent to the UNESCO World Heritage site.
forumMuseumsinsel.design: The fronts are made of burnished brass for an authentic refurbishment of the former main telegraph office.
forumMuseumsinsel.imageAlt: Entry installation at Forum an der Museumsinsel in Berlin
scope: IP technology connected to IP telephony

pulse.subtitle: Flush-mounted, integrated into the façade
pulse.title: Pulse, Berlin
pulse.description: A new commercial building in Berlin Kreuzberg with around 12,000 sqm of rental space across seven floors and an underground car park.
pulse.design: The IP outdoor station is to blend into the white-powder-coated aluminium curtain-wall façade in colour and flush with the surface.
pulse.imageAlt: Flush-mounted Entry installation at the Pulse building in Berlin

weidtParkCorner.subtitle: Integrated into anodised reveal
weidtParkCorner.title: Weidt Park Corner, Berlin
weidtParkCorner.description: An office building completed in 2022 in the heart of Europacity in Berlin.
weidtParkCorner.design: The Entry installations are integrated flush into the specially anodised outer skin, made from exactly the same material as the façade.
weidtParkCorner.imageAlt: Entry installation in anodised reveal at Weidt Park Corner in Berlin

hamburgerFamiliendomizil.subtitle: Outdoor station, letterbox and access control
hamburgerFamiliendomizil.title: Hamburger Familiendomizil
hamburgerFamiliendomizil.description: Exclusive family residence and spacious detached house in a Hamburg villa district.
hamburgerFamiliendomizil.design: All Entry installations integrated flush with the plaster into the exterior wall, black powder-coated with laser personalisation.
hamburgerFamiliendomizil.imageAlt: Plaster-flush Entry installation at a family residence in Hamburg
scope: Door communication with video camera and fingerprint scanner
Inputs integration into ETICS plaster façade

fritzTower.subtitle: In ground stainless steel
fritzTower.title: Berlin residential tower (Fritz Tower)
fritzTower.description: High-quality residential tower with more than 266 apartments in the Mittenmang quarter in Berlin Mitte.
fritzTower.design: Flush installation into the façade elements, vertical alignment matching the façade, in brushed stainless steel.
fritzTower.imageAlt: Entry installation in brushed stainless steel at Fritz Tower in Berlin

potsdamerWohnhaus.subtitle: Signage house numbers
potsdamerWohnhaus.title: Residential building in Potsdam
potsdamerWohnhaus.description: Multi-family house in Potsdam Babelsberg with an illuminated signage house number in stainless steel.
potsdamerWohnhaus.design: House number with LED-backlit digits in brushed stainless steel, matching the video outdoor station.
potsdamerWohnhaus.imageAlt: Entry installation with illuminated signage house number at a residential building in Potsdam
scope: Illuminated signage house number with day/night switching
